description: This file contains unit tests for GatewayChannel connection behavior, including handling concurrent connection attempts and different WebSocket response scenarios, for a macOS application using the OpenClaw SDK.

classes.name: GatewayChannelConnectTests
classes.description: A struct containing asynchronous unit tests for verifying the connection logic of GatewayChannel in various scenarios, including successful connection, failure, and authentication issues.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session with specified response behavior for testing the GatewayChannel connection logic.

methods.name: `concurrent connect is single flight on success`
methods.description: Asserts that multiple concurrent connection attempts result in a single underlying session creation when the connection succeeds.

methods.name: `concurrent connect shares failure`
methods.description: Verifies that concurrent connection attempts fail appropriately and share the failure result when the WebSocket response indicates invalid data.

methods.name: `connect surfaces structured auth failure`
methods.description: Tests that an authentication failure is properly surfaced as a GatewayConnectAuthError with correct properties when the WebSocket response indicates an auth failure.
